messages.text: Kane makes history with record 126th England cap

metadata.summary: Harry Kane has broken the record for the most senior England caps by a single player in history.
metadata.content: Harry Kane: England captain breaks Three Lions' appearance record by winning 126th senior cap vs Croatia at Wembley | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Harry Kane: England captain breaks Three Lions' appearance record by winning 126th senior cap vs Croatia at Wembley Harry Kane became England's most-capped player with start against Croatia in Nations League; Kane passed Peter Shilton's record of 125 caps; history-making moment comes less than three weeks after the 33-year-old became the first English Ballon d'Or winner for 25 years Thursday 12 November 2026 19:48, UK Harry Kane has broken the record for the most senior England caps by a single player in history. The Three Lions captain led the line for Thursday's Nations League game against Croatia, making his 126th appearance for his country in the process. He bypasses the record previously held by goalkeeper Peter Shilton, who earned 125 caps between 1970 and 1990. messages.text: Beirne captains strong Ireland selection vs Fiji as Gibson-Park returns

metadata.summary: Tadhg Beirne will captain a strong Ireland selection vs Fiji in the Nations Championship on Saturday, despite head coach Andy Farrell making seven changes.
metadata.content: Nations Championship: Tadhg Beirne captains strong Ireland selection vs Fiji as Jamison Gibson-Park returns, Rob Baloucoune passed fit | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Nations Championship: Tadhg Beirne captains strong Ireland selection vs Fiji as Jamison Gibson-Park returns, Rob Baloucoune passed fit Andy Farrell's Ireland host Fiji at Aviva Stadium, Dublin on Saturday in Nations Championship (8.10pm); team selection shows seven changes to thumping win vs Argentina as Jamison Gibson-Park, Tommy O'Brien, Bundee Aki, Jamie Osborne, Ronan Kelleher, James Ryan, Josh van der Flier come in Michael Cantillon Sports Journalist Thursday 12 November 2026 14:22, UK Image: Tadhg Beirne will captain Ireland on Saturday as they host Fiji in the Nations Championship Tadhg Beirne will captain a strong Ireland selection vs Fiji in the Nations Championship on Saturday, despite head coach Andy Farrell making seven changes. Two of those changes are enforced as hooker Dan Sheehan (concussion) and No 8 Sean Jansen (knee) were ruled out, but several other injury concerns have been allayed. Indeed, wing Rob Baloucoune is fit to start again, as is Mack Hansen despite an ankle knock - the latter shifting to full-back with Hugo Keenan rested and Tommy O'Brien brought into the back-three. Josh van der Flier is also fit despite his own ankle complaint, starting at openside flanker with Nick Timoney shifting to No 8 in the absence of Jansen, Jack Conan and Caelan Doris due to injury.
